sourceFacts.fact: Iron deficiency can result from inadequate intake, impaired absorption or blood loss.
Iron is required for haemoglobin synthesis, so inadequate availability can cause anaemia.

Three arrows converge into large middle4 with sparse Fe tokens, then one arrow down to5 with a partly completed row of plain blocks labelled Hb. Exactly five nodes and four main arrows. Bottom note: Think about intake, absorption and losses. Avoid gut, blood cells, bone marrow, bleeding wounds or foods. Inventories are only a supply metaphor.
